hypothesis: In a Douady-Couder disc model (each new primordium placed at the global minimum, on the circle r = R0, of the summed repulsive energy of all existing primordia, which recede on a disc growing exponentially at rate G per plastochron), every attractor class with estimated basin measure above 0.01 at any growth parameter G in the sweep is one of the listed noble classes: constant divergence at the golden angle (137.5078 deg), constant divergence at the Lucas angle (99.5016 deg), or a bijugate period-2 divergence sequence (pi alternating with half the golden angle, 68.7539 deg, or with half the Lucas angle, 49.7508 deg). Secondary (claim-level, as mathematics only): the visible opposed parastichy pair of the dominant attractor rises as G falls, i.e. parastichy numbers vary with the size of the structure relative to the primordia, as thompson1917-ch14-05 states for sunflower discs.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered, primary (list test). For every G in the sweep, every unclassified class has estimated measure (fraction of the seeds at that G) at most 0.01. A seed is classified to a listed class if each of its last 50 folded divergence angles |d| (d wrapped to (-pi, pi]) lies within 1e-3 rad of the class pattern: constant golden; constant Lucas; or period-2 alternating (pi, golden/2) or (pi, Lucas/2) in either phase. Unclassified seeds at a G are grouped into classes by signature: constant (all 50 within 1e-3 of their median), period-2, period-3 or period-4 (each residue class within 1e-3 of its median), else 'non-periodic'; signatures are merged by single linkage at 1e-3 rad on their sorted median values. If the primary passes, the atlas fails to falsify the list (it cannot prove full measure).
fail_criterion: Pre-registered, primary (list test). The classified list fails (is falsified as a complete list for this model) if at any G any unclassified class has estimated measure above 0.01 (point estimate of the fraction of the 500 seeds; the 95% bootstrap percentile interval is reported alongside). Expected caveat stated in advance: on a growing disc at finite G the Fibonacci-branch divergence is a continuous function of G and equals the golden angle only in the limit G -> 0, so the strict 1e-3 rad list test is expected to fail at most G; this is recorded, not tuned away. A separate failure signature is a simulator bug: on the cross-check seeds, the vectorized and the reference scalar implementation disagree on the terminal divergence angle by more than 1e-3 rad. Secondary, branch-level list (reported, does not change the primary list outcome): constant-divergence classes whose opposed parastichy pair (m, n) in the conformal (log-polar) lattice generated by (d, G) is a pair of consecutive Fibonacci numbers (including distichy, d = pi) are 'Fibonacci branch'; consecutive Lucas numbers (1,3),(3,4),(4,7),(7,11),(11,18),(18,29),(29,47) are 'Lucas branch'; period-2 classes with one folded angle within 0.05 rad of pi are 'bijugate branch'; the branch list fails if any other class has measure above 0.01 at any G. Claim-level verdict for thompson1917-ch14-05 (computational): 'supports' if the modal class's parastichy pair takes at least 3 distinct values across the sweep and Spearman rho between G and m+n over G values is <= -0.9; 'refutes' if the modal class has a single parastichy pair across the whole sweep; otherwise 'mixed'.
planned_method: Douady-Couder disc rule, fixed here. Units: R0 = 1 (radius of the circle on which primordia are born), time in plastochrons T = 1. A primordium born at step j sits at angle theta_j and radius r_j(k) = exp(G (k - j)) at step k, i.e. radial velocity proportional to radius, dr/dt = G r, so G = V0 T / R0 with V0 the radial velocity at R0 (the role of G in Douady and Couder 1992). Repulsion kernel: E(d) = d^-3 (power law with exponent eta = 3, the parallel-dipole repulsion of the 1992 ferrofluid experiment), summed over existing primordia: E_k(theta) = sum_j (1 + r_j^2 - 2 r_j cos(theta - theta_j))^(-3/2). New primordium k is placed at the global minimizer of E_k(theta) over theta in [0, 2 pi): E_k is evaluated on a uniform grid of 720 angles, the three lowest local grid minima are refined by golden-section search on their bracketing grid interval to 1e-10 rad, and the lowest refined value wins. Numerical truncation: primordia with r_j - 1 > 10 (energy contribution < 1e-3 each, and a nearly uniform far field) are dropped from the sum; the kept count is recorded. Initial condition per seed: n0 = 3 primordia at i.i.d. uniform random angles, ages 2, 1, 0 plastochrons (radii exp(2G), exp(G), 1), then the rule places primordia 4..300 (300 primordia in total, including the 3 seeded). Sweep: G at 200 log-spaced values from 0.02 to 1.0; 500 seeds per G; the same 500 initial-angle triples at every G (common random numbers) drawn from numpy.random.default_rng(20261101). Divergence d_k = theta_k - theta_{k-1} wrapped to (-pi, pi]; analysis uses the last 50 (k = 251..300), folded |d| so mirror-image chiralities share a class. Basin volume of a class at G = fraction of the 500 seeds in it; 95% interval = 2.5/97.5 percentiles of 1000 bootstrap resamples of the 500 seeds (numpy.random.default_rng(20261102)). Cross-check: an independent scalar pure-Python implementation (no vectorization, grid of 3600 angles plus golden-section refinement of the best 3 grid minima) is run on 4 seeds at each of 5 G values spread over the sweep; disagreement > 1e-3 rad in any of the last 50 folded divergences is recorded as a simulator-bug signature. Deviation rule fixed in advance: if the full 200 x 500 x 300 grid cannot finish in the session, the largest grid that finishes is run (fewer G values, evenly thinned, and/or fewer seeds), the 0.01 criterion is kept unchanged, and exactly what was run is recorded in measured.extra.

test_contract.expected_observation: No attractor class outside {golden, Lucas, bijugate-golden, bijugate-Lucas} (1e-3 rad over the last 50 divergence angles) has basin measure above 0.01 at any swept G in the Douady-Couder disc model.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: Some class outside that list has an estimated basin measure above 0.01 at some G.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: None: computational output of the pre-registered Douady-Couder disc rule only; no biological data.
test_contract.inference_method: Monte Carlo basin volumes (500 seeds per G, 200 G values) with 1000-resample bootstrap percentile intervals; threshold 0.01 on the point estimate of each unclassified class's fraction. Falsification only: a pass cannot prove full measure.
